snippet.title: Psalm 1 - (Ever Blessed)
snippet.description:
'Psalm 1' (Ever-Blessed) is part of the Jubilee Church 'The Psalms of Summer' worship collective

These worship songs accompany our 'Psalms of Summer' sermon series. Each song is based on one of the books of Psalms. As David wrote songs to express his love for God and at times, his need for rescue and forgiveness, we also express our need for Him in our lives and we rejoice over what He has done for us!!!

We pray that these songs help usher you into a deeper connection with God and remind you that you are 'Ever-Blessed', not by works, but by the grace of God!

Lyrics
I was walking on the road of the wicked
I was standing in the door of sin
I was sitting in the seat of the skeptic
I was dust in the wind

I was living on the far side of judgement
Had no hope and no defense
No purpose and no direction
I was lost in the wilderness

You set me on the path of blessing
On a road marked by faithfulness
Though I stumble I will keep confessing
That I’m walking in Your goodness

I’m ever-blessed
I'm ever-prosperous
My soul’s at rest
Cause I’m walking with the Lord

Though the way of the Lord is narrow
And few stay on it for life
Heaven waits for those who finish
For glory will be their prize
